description:
GPs and medical centres, pharmacies, dentists, hospitals and vets: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/health-services`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_gps, per_1000_gps, nearest_km_gps, count_pharmacies, per_1000_pharmacies, nearest_km_pharmacies, count_dentists, per_1000_dentists, nearest_km_dentists, count_hospitals, per_1000_hospitals, nearest_km_hospitals, count_vets, per_1000_vets, nearest_km_vets, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_amenities_health_services
title: Suburb · Health services nearby
